messages:
Nina (PM): quick sync  customer request: a "Throughput Tokens" addon that guarantees reserved request tokens during scheduled peaks. pricing + scope?
Raj (Infra): sounds like reserving QPS budget + token bucket enforcement. need to decide shared vs per-tenant reservation.
Lena (Sales): customer wants predictable throughput for campaigns. they'd pay a fixed monthly fee + token top-ups.
Omar (Finance): propose two price pieces: base reservation fee + per-token consumed price. need modeling: idle cost vs expected usage.
Nina (PM): constraints: Dedicated & Private only; opt-in per-app; pilot with two customers.
Raj (Infra): implementation pieces: token allocator, ingress token-check, warm workers for tokens, telemetry. rough MLP 4-6 sprints for shared, 10+ for per-tenant reserved infra.
Ops-bot: note: warm-worker experiment increased idle GPU by ~6% last month. /ops/exp/42
Tess (Legal): from legal: require clear metric definition, credit cap, and force majeure carveouts. recommend max credit = 40% of addon revenue per year.
Nina (PM): launch checklist draft: 1) metric spec for token consumption + dropped requests 2) billing automation for token billing & credits 3) pilot agreement template 4) runbook for token exhaustion
Lena (Sales): pilot success criteria: stable throughput during 3 scheduled peaks, <1.5x cost uplift. also test messaging: "Throughput Tokens" vs "Burst Credits".
Omar (Finance): I'll run pricing sensitivity for 3 attach-rate scenarios and include amortized idle cost.
Raj (Infra): config example for discussion:
```
throughput_tokens:
  enabled: true
  mode: shared
  reserved_qps: 200
  token_window: "60s"
```
Nina (PM): good next steps: Raj prototype token allocator, Omar pricing model, Tess draft addendum, Lena recruit pilots. logging this to roadmap Q3.
Ops-bot: reminder: infra prototype sync Friday 9am.
Nina (PM): closing thread.
